caption: Melee maneuver: flanking maneuver. An engaged player Infantry regiment (80 soldiers) locks in melee combat with an opposing enemy line (40 soldiers, 8 files wide). Under the Flanking maneuver stance, the unit expands its frontage to 12 files (8 enemy files + 4 wrap files), wrapping its outer ranks around both flanks of the enemy line while maintaining forward line facing.
